short_description: Run a single-elimination desk tournament with byes, undo and up to eight entrants.
description: Run a single-elimination desk tournament with byes, undo and up to eight entrants. Set participant names separated by commas in settings. The first round automatically gives byes when needed. During a match, turn to select the winner and click to advance. Start undoes the last result. Hold Start restarts the bracket from the configured entrants.
